from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem

mol = Chem.MolFromMolBlock("mol2d.mol")

nconf = 40
cids = AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(molH, numConfs=nconf, randomSeed=0xf00d, useRandomCoords=False, maxAttempts=50)
print("embedded", len(cids))
res = AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(molH, maxIters=2000)
energies = [(e, i) for i,(conv,e) in enumerate(res)]
energies.sort()
for e,i in energies[:6]:
    print(i, round(e,3))
best = energies[0][1]
conf = molH.GetConformer(best)
# check stereo preserved
mol_check = Chem.RemoveHs(Chem.Mol(molH))
print("after embed:", Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(mol_check, includeUnassigned=True, useLegacyImplementation=False))
AllChem.MolToMolFile(molH, "opt_conf.mol", confId=best)
EOF

from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem
mol = Chem.MolFromMolFile("opt_conf.mol", removeHs=False)
m = Chem.RemoveHs(mol)
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
print(Chem.FindMolChiralCenters(m, includeUnassigned=True, useLegacyImplementation=False))
# ring fusion dihedral checks: e-f (4-5), f-k? etc.
conf = m.GetConformer()
import numpy as np
def dih(i,j,k,l):
    p = [np.array(conf.GetAtomPosition(x)) for x in (i,j,k,l)]
    b1,b2,b3 = p[1]-p[0], p[2]-p[1], p[3]-p[2]
    n1 = np.cross(b1,b2); n2 = np.cross(b2,b3)
    ang = np.degrees(np.arctan2(np.dot(np.cross(n1,n2), b2/np.linalg.norm(b2)), np.dot(n1,n2)))
    return ang
# ring2/ring3 fusion bond f-e (5-4): neighbors g(6) on f side, d(3) on e side

from rdkit import Chem

for atom in mol.GetAtoms():

    lines.append("%-3s %14.8f %14.8f %14.8f" % (atom.GetSymbol(), p.x, p.y, p.z))

print("written", mol.GetNumAtoms(), "atoms")

**Summary of what was built:**

The 2D drawing depicts a steroid/triterpenoid-type molecule (C₃₁H₄₆O₅) consisting of:
- A **cyclopentane ring** (top right) bearing an isopropenyl group [C(CH₃)=CH₂] on a hashed bond and a methyl ester (–COOCH₃) on a bold wedge at the quaternary carbon
